title: 8Z TSP / Route Planning Core Context — Light
purpose: Core BD route-planning/TSP arena principles for cross-domain transfer into new solvers or labs.

blocks.title: Core stance
blocks.text: Three research paths stay alive in parallel: current MSTD, MSTD completion, and MSTD-MR/local specialization. Arena decides; do not kill any path early.

blocks.title: Source of truth
blocks.text: JSON is source of truth. CSV is derived export only. Maintain manifests, code fingerprints, worker/fleet transparency, and honest reporting of execution mode.

blocks.title: Validated baseline principle
blocks.text: Phase 0 was treated as closed only after smoke/overnight validation. Bugfix stage ends when manifests, backend transparency, worker/GPU conflicts, and continuation semantics are validated.

blocks.title: Run discipline
blocks.text: Record workers_used, fleet_used, backend requested/effective, module loaded flags, and preserve CPU fleet when auto acceleration would conflict with workers. Prefer reproducible tests over pretty claims.

usage_instruction: Use only what is relevant. Cite CTX ids when relying on this context. If context is insufficient or conflicts with the task, say so explicitly.
